owned_shutdown: Every final Rust peer joins three listeners/workers, observes closed/rebindable ports and zero runtime tasks. Java closes its Admin and checks zero live Admin threads. Runner parent-waits all final processes, including its finally path. Cancellation observes worker EOF while Admin lives and then reuses the same Admin.
retained_failures: Initial tests ignored map insertion and shutdown results; exact source/compile failures retained.

The peer initially advertised88 instead of89; that pre-execution source is retained and corrected.

Next genuine run showed Java can discover through any Metadata broker. The old bootstrap-only peer assertion failed; the new peer allows that while Rust bootstrap routing is checked separately.

First all-feature full suite rejected an assertion tying coordinator order to numeric nodes; address order varies with ephemeral ports. The test now checks both targets without constraining address order and separately checks caller result order.
A binary-selection probe found Clippy and executable fingerprints for all features; final selection also requires an actual executable. No SDK execution was qualified from the ambiguous selection.
limits: Selected scripted GROUP peers and genuine public Java Admin calls/builders/parsers. This does not qualify a live Streams coordinator, membership persistence, a broker implementation or a Streams execution engine.
Rust requires explicit v0 opt-in; a wire version cannot identify release stability. No assertion about the default Java policy is inferred from the explicitly configured calls.

Response-entry fields are preserved. Java returns a deduplicated Map and future errors; Rust returns caller order/duplicates, raw API89 terminal errors and separately sourced discovery/capability/transport failures. Root throttle is not part of the returned per-group description.

Local malformed/budget failures and the whole deadline fail the operation; successful groups survive other groups retrying or terminal discovery/capability failures. Cancellation sends no membership mutation.

Encoding/decoding and aggregate result limits cover requested slot/string storage, not allocator rounding/RSS. Shared ApiVersions/TLS/SASL transport limits are unchanged; response admission occurs after the shared bounded frame read.
Operation sockets are new and owned by the Admin mutable lease; no additional socket is cached after return. Existing Admin connection requirements/caches remain. No warm-latency or speed claim.
Exact tested source is pushed to a review branch; the working HEAD/index stay unchanged. Local checks do not claim hosted CI, main merge, release or production readiness.
The required conformance ledger remains incomplete; this qualification is a client component and public-call cohort.
